verdict.rationale: Mistral documents official Python and TypeScript SDK clients (installed via `pip install mistralai`) and its own Agents API with tools and multi-agent handoffs. llms.txt also indexes an MCP page, though the mention is thin. None of the evidence shows documented official integrations into third-party coding agents or agent frameworks, and no skills or plugins are evidenced. Missing for 10: documented official integrations with external coding agents and agent frameworks, skills or plugin packages, detail on MCP support, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-framework use.
